mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing fair conditions near the Verona Public Library. Also, keep your eyes on the skies tonight at 5:43 PM to spot the International Space Station as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the Fitchburg area for a 5-minute flyover.
The Plan Commission has several development projects on the docket for December 7th, while the Municipal Court reminds residents that they can handle non-mandatory citations online or by mail.
Today features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard, with even more music at Paddy Mac's and the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol happening tomorrow.
On October 25th, officers located a driver at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an O W I arrest.
You can enjoy today's flavor of the day, Raspberry Cheesecake, at Culver's until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
